metric_definitions.answer_correctness: Mean rule score for required answer terms present and forbidden terms absent.
metric_definitions.average_cost_per_query_usd: Mean cost_usd supplied by responses or eval cases; zero when no model cost is reported.
metric_definitions.citation_accuracy: Mean fraction of expected citation sources present in returned citations.
metric_definitions.context_precision: Mean fraction of retrieved citations that are expected relevant sources.
metric_definitions.faithfulness: Mean fraction of answer-required terms supported by retrieved context snippets.
metric_definitions.mrr_at_10: Mean reciprocal rank of the first expected relevant source in the top 10 retrieved citations.
metric_definitions.p95_end_to_end_latency_ms: 95th percentile measured wall-clock latency for full eval queries, including generation.
metric_definitions.p95_retrieval_latency_ms: 95th percentile reported retrieval latency for eval queries.
metric_definitions.recall_at_5: Fraction of cases where at least one expected relevant source appears in the top 5 retrieved citations.
metric_definitions.refusal_accuracy: Mean correctness for cases marked should_refuse; non-refusal cases count as correct when the answer does not refuse.
metric_definitions.user_satisfaction: Mean optional satisfaction score supplied in eval cases.
